caption:
the fridge had a plan all along 🙃

#healthy #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
Dinner came from *one line*
about my fridge

Told it what was there

In one line

Lemon garlic salmon
came back

Sized to what's left today

It walks the steps

Rice first —
about 12 minutes

"Log this meal" — one tap

Dinner became data

slides.heading: From fridge to logged
slides.body: SOMA turns what's in the kitchen into dinner, walks the cooking, and logs it into your day — one flow
